courses.note: Elective in the joint CS and Mathematics curriculum sheet (listed there as CoSc 535; the course page now carries the number COSC 465, and the 2026 catalog lists CS 465 as required for the standalone CS major). Computer Networks (COSC 475) is the required networks course. No public syllabus found; only Pepperdine's provost-level sample AI statements, which are templates.

notes: Seaver College offers no stand-alone computer science major; its computer science degree is a joint major with Mathematics (the curriculum sheet lists Math 220 and 221 alongside COSC 220 and 221). The frame courses come from that curriculum sheet and the Seaver catalog course pages; the 2026 catalog PDF is at https://seaver.pepperdine.edu/academics/content/seaver-academic-catalog-2026-v4a.pdf. None of the four frame courses has a public syllabus; instructors use the LMS. Pepperdine's provost-level AI syllabus statements are optional templates, so the course layer is empty here.
